prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Miami for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone — it depends on where you are in Miami, your age, insurance, treatment goals (metal braces vs Invisalign), budget, and what “best” means to you (fastest, most aesthetic, most affordable, friendliest with kids, etc.). I can help you find the best match. A few quick questions first:

- Do you want braces or Invisalign (or are you open to either)?
- Are you in a particular neighborhood or ZIP code in Miami?
- Is this for a child or an adult?
- Do you have orthodontic insurance or a provider/plan you must use?

How to choose the best orthodontist (checklist)
- Board certification: Preferably American Board of Orthodontics (ABO) certified — this indicates advanced training and examination.
- Experience with your treatment: Look for an orthodontist who treats many Invisalign cases if you want aligners (Invisalign “Preferred/Platinum/Diamond” provider levels indicate volume).
- Before/after photos: Ask to see cases like yours.
- Technology: iTero/3D scanners, CBCT imaging, digital treatment planning can improve accuracy and comfort.
- Clear treatment plan: Length of treatment, alternatives, expected results, retention plan.
- Reviews and referrals: Google, Yelp, Healthgrades, RealSelf, and personal recommendations.
- Communication & comfort: Comfort with the doctor and staff, clarity about cost and payment/financing.
- Follow-up care and emergency policy: Who handles issues while in treatment?
- Pricing & financing: Get written estimates including all appliances/retainers.

Questions to ask at a consult
1. Am I a good candidate for Invisalign (if that’s your preference)? Why or why not?
2. How many cases like mine have you treated, and can I see photos?
3. What is the estimated treatment time and total cost? What’s included?
4. Are you board-certified? What continuing education do you do?
5. What happens if I break a bracket or lose an aligner?
6. Do you accept my insurance? What financing options are available?

Where to search
- American Association of Orthodontists (AAO) “Find an Orthodontist”
- Invisalign provider locator (for providers who do aligners)
- Google Maps/Yelp for local ratings and patient photos
- Ask your dentist for a referral

If you want, I can:
- Give a short list of highly rated orthodontists in Miami (tell me your ZIP or neighborhood)
- Draft an email/text you can send to providers to ask the important questions
- Help evaluate options once you have quotes or consult reports

Tell me ZIP/neighborhood and whether you prefer Invisalign or braces, and I’ll look up and recommend a few local practices to contact.
